mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates on future corporate earnings and increases the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of a near-term recession and triggers risk-off behavior in equity markets, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for 3 months, or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in walk-forward testing.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening demand in the housing and retail sectors, which reduces near-term corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 in walk-forward analysis.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic momentum and triggers equity market sell-offs due to reduced corporate profitability expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 100 periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction (HOUST) above 900,000 units combined with a rise in consumer spending (RSAFS) above $430 billion signals a recovery in household demand, which boosts near-term corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 900 and RSAFS > 430000 fails to predict positive SPX 5-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 in walk-forward testing.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year signals rising inflation pressures, which increases the probability of a Federal Reserve rate hike, leading to higher discount rates and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5%, or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 per month combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.5% signals a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 200000 and UNRATE < 5.5% fails to predict positive SPX 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 in walk-forward analysis.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized over the past 6 months signals a weakening economy, which increases the likelihood of a recession and triggers risk-off behavior in equity markets, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during GDPC1 < 1.0% growth periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
